verdict.rationale: Cline documents signing in once to its own Cline provider to use models directly, and it offers ClinePass, a $9.99/month subscription, so signing in with a Cline plan to drive the agent is supported. The evidence ties sign-in to prepaid credits rather than explicitly to the subscription, and ClinePass only covers "popular open coding models." Missing for 10: explicit docs showing that signing in activates ClinePass inside the agent, coverage of the plan across all models and surfaces (CLI, IDE, JetBrains), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with my existing product subscription plan to use the coding agent

citations.quote: you sign in once, add Cline credits, and select from available models directly in Cline
ClinePass is a low-cost monthly subscription — $9.99/month — that offers 2-5x the usage on popular open coding models compared to standard API rate.
